p: hide my commandments with thee: That is, keep them in your heart.
thine heart to understanding: If you give yourself to the true knowledge of God without hypocrisy.
liftest up thy voice for understanding: Meaning that we must seek the knowledge of God with care and diligence.
treasures: Showing that no labour must be spared.
knowledge of God: This (he says) is the true wisdom to know and fear God.
Discretion shall preserve thee: The word of God will guide you, and teach you how to govern yourself.
paths of uprightness: That is, the word of God, which is the only light, to follow their own fantasies which are darkness.
in the frowardness of the wicked: When they see any given to evil as they are.
woman: Meaning, the wisdom which is the word of God, will preserve us from all vices: naming this vice of whoredom to which man is most prone.
guide of her youth: That is, her husband, who is her head and guide to govern her, from whom she ought not to depart, but remain in his subjection.
house inclineth unto death: Her acquaintance with her spirits and they that haunt her.
the dead: To them who are dead in body and soul.
land: They will enjoy the temporal and spiritual promises of God, as the wicked will be void of them.
